message: Designer is checking the furniture layout

Yes—the muted sage sofa works well with the floor’s light, warm greige appearance in this render. Both are subdued, so the contrast feels calm rather than stark. Cream walls and the sandy rug soften the palette; walnut and oak tones add warmth, while the terracotta chair and brass lamp provide accents. The sage kitchen sideboard ties the spaces together.

One optional small improvement: a slightly deeper terracotta shade on the existing lounge chair would give the seating area more definition.

Nothing has been changed.
